statement: Compile a valid BehaviorSpec into PromptIR and render a deterministic prompt without embedding target-specific laws in the compiler.
notes: The test exercises BehaviorSpec validation, PromptIR construction, and prompt rendering as one observable compilation contract.

statement: Use bounded Tlaloque findings to propose and apply prompt repairs across a finite number of generations.
notes: The trainer has an explicit generation bound and repairs a demonstrated premature-collapse failure.

statement: Keep promotion decisions outside proposal workers and reject promotion based only on mock evidence or an experimental mutation.
notes: Tlaloc may evaluate and recommend; target and stack promotion remain external authority boundaries.

statement: Evaluate coherent-state operations against deterministic reference semantics that preserve alternatives, cancellation, and coupled state.
notes: This claim covers deterministic reference behavior, not empirical model capability.

statement: Execute text requests through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint while preserving the declared behavior input and output boundary.
notes: Transport compatibility is implementation evidence, not evidence that a remote model satisfies a behavior.

statement: Execute declared image and tool-loop requests through OpenAI-compatible multimodal transports.
notes: A successful transport exchange is not a semantic benchmark pass.

statement: Provide the origami.quantum-inspired.r0 behavior profile and execute its deterministic coherent-state reference semantics.
notes: The profile exists at behavior-lab/profiles/origami/quantum-inspired-r0.json; the tests cover its core reference invariants.

statement: Run perceptual transport variants and apply deterministic, evidence-gated campaign evaluation without exposing evaluator ground truth to the model.
notes: The machinery is implemented; this claim does not assert empirical support for any perceptual channel.

statement: Execute all seven Origami perceptual-channel operations as native Tlaloc runtime capabilities.
notes: Main contains transport, evaluators, and partial runtime support, but no test demonstrates native execution of all seven declared channel operations.

statement: Persist immutable run-scoped worker observations, preserve conflicts, and consolidate only when the declared evidence threshold is met.
notes: Implemented on published main after the original evidence plan described this area as historical design.

statement: Reduce evidence-bearing candidates into canonical state using explicit cardinality and replaceable deterministic fusion policies while retaining conflicts.
notes: Candidate observations remain distinct from canonical facts.

statement: Resolve Requires and Produces contracts into a typed dependency DAG and expose products by contract rather than producer identity.
notes: Published main contains executable typed dataflow despite the historical plan classifying Causal Dataflow as designed.

statement: Execute ALL, ANY, and QUORUM dependency joins with explicit node state transitions and tolerated-failure policies.
notes: Join semantics are recorded separately from typed product resolution because either contract can regress independently.

statement: Build and execute pinned multi-worker ensemble plans with an explicit fusion boundary and declared quorum or all-member behavior.
notes: This claim covers executable composition, not empirical superiority over a single worker.

statement: Build condition-specific empirical failure profiles and use sufficient shared evidence to select complementary ensemble members deterministically.
notes: Selection falls back to the baseline strategy when empirical evidence is insufficient.

statement: Execute behavior requests through a native Anthropic transport backend.
notes: No native Anthropic implementation or associated test exists on published main.

statement: Compile behavior into SkillIR and generate portable agent skills from that intermediate representation.
notes: docs/CAPABILITY_STATUS.md explicitly marks SkillIR and generated skills as not implemented.

statement: Select and execute specialized runtime backends by model family under a common behavior contract.
notes: Main can detect model families and vary compatibility metadata, but no tested family-specific backend contract exists.

statement: Operate distinct Model Lab, Composition Lab, and Design Lab levels with promotion gates between them.
notes: The repository contains behavior-lab machinery, but no test demonstrates the complete three-level contract described in the historical architecture.

statement: Use a Markov decision process with explicit actions and rewards to select runtime or design policies.
notes: Published main has deterministic and empirical selection policies, not a tested MDP implementation.

statement: Automatically design, train, benchmark, and promote a new Tlaloque specialist from an unmet capability goal.
notes: Main resolves and composes registered workers but does not test the complete auto-creation and promotion lifecycle.

statement: Emit immutable model-run records with a canonical environment hash, monthly index, and executable replay that reproduces deterministic output.
notes: The first active integration records the deterministic realcampaign prepare path; trace remains empty until the trajectory phase.
